# Add `--version` Flag to Ralph CLI

Add version reporting to the `ralph` CLI using Clap's built-in version support.

## Requirements

- Add `--version` flag to the CLI that prints the version from `Cargo.toml`
- Use Clap's built-in version attribute (don't implement manually)
- Version should be derived automatically from the package metadata
- Should follow standard CLI conventions (`-V` short form, `--version` long form)

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `ralph --version` prints the version number from `Cargo.toml`
- [ ] `ralph -V` works as a short form
- [ ] Version is automatically sourced from package metadata (no hardcoded strings)
- [ ] Implementation uses Clap's built-in version support
